curve.model: binary Weierstrass y^2 + xy = x^3 + a*x^2 + b

endomorphism.proof_status: Sage replay verifies Frobenius action and exact order on G; conductors and volcano levels are undetermined

factor_base.construction: Scan polynomial-basis x words starting at 1 in ascending order; lift x to curve points; multiply by the cofactor to project to the prime-order subgroup; reject identity and x <= 1; retain the first representative for each minimum x in its Frobenius orbit; append its complete signed Frobenius orbit.
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient: complete +/- Frobenius orbit; labels are +/- lambda^j times the representative logarithm mod r
factor_base.subgroup_filter: cofactor projection from curve points; identity excluded; Sage replay verifies every retained point has order r

field.representation: polynomial basis; coefficient of x^i is bit i

algorithm_affecting_flags.target_s3_call_count_policy: charge each S3 query as visited

implementation.build_profile: release; default target and feature flags from Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock

point_decomposition.cache_policy: build factor base and pair index once per process; no shared process cache across measured runs
point_decomposition.equation_order: indexed representative-pair S3 followed by target-pair S3 and exact four-point group verification
point_decomposition.implementation_version: parallel S3-root index-state construction plus 64 deterministic hash-sharded open-addressed root tables, preserving serial first-witness selection; target-span stopping; source digest in implementation; isolated baseline rebuild
point_decomposition.orientation_policy: sample exactly one target-seeded pseudorandom global Frobenius shift per quotient S3 state; SplitMix64 derives it from the target point hash, state offset, and state indices, then reduces modulo n (with the resulting small modulo bias)
point_decomposition.query_inversion_policy: solve each target S3 query separately in indexed root order
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial_chain: Build the pair index from S3 x-coordinate roots for representative pairs and relative Frobenius shifts; query S3 roots against Q.x, canonicalize the partner under Frobenius, join through the second pair index, lift x coordinates through the factor-base buckets, then verify the exact four-point group sum.
point_decomposition.weierstrass_descent_encoding: S3 x-coordinate roots in the polynomial basis; a derived normal basis represents Frobenius as cyclic bit rotation

relation_collection.duplicate_dependency_policy: retain every verified relation; after each rank gain test whether the target coefficient vector lies in the current row space
relation_collection.filtering: S3-root candidate, canonical root-table lookup, factor-base x-bucket lift, and exact group-sum check
relation_collection.parallel_policy: Generate unique known-scalar targets in deterministic batches of 14; search each batch concurrently; insert completed relations in query order; stop after the full batch containing the first target-span proof. The S3-root index state generation, canonical-root scattering, and 64 hash-shard insertions use 14 workers; worker chunks are merged in the original left/right/relative order within each hash shard to preserve serial first-witness selection. If target decomposition fails or the attempt cap is reached without a span proof, continue to full rank.
relation_collection.rule: decompose the public target; sample ordinary known-scalar subgroup targets; collect four-point Frobenius-slice relations until the target coefficient vector lies in their verified row space
relation_collection.stop_criterion: first completed batch where the target four-column coefficient vector is in the row space of verified relation rows; otherwise full rank or max(8*columns, columns+32) unique relation attempts
relation_collection.target_distribution: SplitMix64 stream output reduced modulo (r-1), plus 1, to form known nonzero scalars a and targets [a]G; scalar duplicates are skipped; modulo reduction has a small bias; relation seed belongs to the workload/run record
relation_collection.verification: exact group relation before insertion; independent Sage replay of all witnesses

relation_linear_algebra.implementation: in-process modular echelon elimination; final logs independently re-solved in Sage
relation_linear_algebra.matrix_construction: four signed-orbit label coefficients per verified relation, accumulated by factor-base orbit column
relation_linear_algebra.orbit_quotient: signed Frobenius orbits; one column per representative
relation_linear_algebra.rank_criterion: target coefficient vector in verified relation row space; fall back to full column rank when target decomposition is absent or no target span is found

target_descent.policy: recover the target scalar as the right-hand-side combination of verified relation rows that spans the target's signed-Frobenius coefficient vector; if full rank is reached first, recover from representative logs
target_descent.success_rule: exact four-point relation, recovered scalar, and [d]G=Q replay
